articles.author: Alexandra Marquez
articles.title: State Department urges Americans to consider leaving Middle East as regional conflict escalates - NBC News
articles.description: The State Department on Saturday urged Americans across the Middle East to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart on short notice, warning of flight disruptions and security risks as the conflict with Iran escalates.
